description: Implementation of MediaTimeProvider class handling media timing, playback control, and synchronization.

classes.name: MediaTimeProviderImpl
classes.description: Class managing media playback timing, including play, pause, seek, and playback rate adjustments.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Starts media playback, updating internal timing state.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses media playback, updating internal timing state.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback speed for media.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified media time.

methods.name: GetCurrentMediaTime
methods.description: Retrieves current media time and playback status flags.

methods.name: GetCurrentMediaTime_Locked
methods.description: Calculates current media time based on internal state and system clock.
